title: Initialized constant registers
statement: For every natural number $N$ and every machine memory $m$ with $W$-bit values, after the straight-line initialization of the constant registers and pool, the register at the one address contains the $W$-bit representation of $1$, the register at the zero address contains the representation of $0$, and the register at the negative-one address contains the representation of $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a memory assigning a $W$-bit value to each integer address
